description: Five independent processes per language of the redact-secret-adapters overhead-v2 harnesses at the v2 workload digest, run alternately and sequentially on one workstation, current build only (no --baseline). Measurements only; the budgets derived from them are in benchmarks/regression-budgets.json.

provenance.hostClass: Apple M4, macOS (Darwin 25.5.0), Node 22.16.0, CPython 3.14.7, one workstation, no CPU pinning, other processes running
provenance.adapterSourceNote: A clean checkout of adapters develop at this commit (source.dirty false in every output), built with npm run build; the Python package installed in a venv from python/.
provenance.command: node scripts/measure-overhead.mjs --out js-N.json; python scripts/measure-overhead.py --out py-N.json (defaults: 15 repetitions x 400 events, 200 warm-up events per mode), alternating, N=1..5
provenance.machineLoad: 1-minute load average sampled at the start and end of each process ranged 3.4 to 22.0 on 10 logical CPUs

method.order: modes interleaved within each repetition, rotated by one position per repetition

limitations: Host-dependent: these numbers describe this machine and runtime only.
Per-event times are batch means over eventsPerRepetition events; the distribution is across repetitions, not across single events.
Single-event latencies include one clock read of overhead each; memory repetitions start from a forced collection, which the batch and latency passes do not.
memory counts the V8 heap only: native allocations inside the core are not included.
derived values are differences of medians, not medians of differences, and can be negative within noise.
The OpenTelemetry exporter is a no-op, so export cost is excluded; pino writes to a no-op destination, so I/O cost is excluded.

mcp-js and mcp-stream-js have no host around them either: mcp-js measures sanitizeToolResult over one tool result per payload event, mcp-stream-js sanitizeStreamedToolResult over one chunk per message and tool result, awaited per event.
ai-context-js has no host around it: its host mode is the empty call, and it measures buildContext over whole-input scans only, not a stream.
This output carries no threshold and no verdict.
